Resolves #18685

Refs #17540

`learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsStateAndPersistence.md` said a restore hands its document to the workspace "with no operation involved". That is true of the route the guide measures and false of the Neural Link's: restoring a saved layout onto a workspace that belongs to a Group commits it as `applyDocument`, through the same normalize-and-validate commit as any edit. The paragraph now names each route with its condition instead of generalising one of them, and `Where to go next` picks up the windows guide, which landed after this guide was written.

Evidence: L3 (portal render of the edited page in headless Chromium against a merged-guide control driven along the same path, plus an independent clean-Mermaid control) → L2 required (documentation of existing behaviour). The route claims themselves are source reads at this PR's base, named in AC-2. No residual beyond the cross-family review this PR requests.
